source.title: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit
notes: 2025 sRGB Moon color map for 3D rendering.
Adapted by NASA SVS from LROC WAC color data and lower-resolution polar albedo data.
The NASA SVS page notes that this map is optimized for aesthetics; scientific applications should use the source data.
Stored locally so the public page does not load NASA imagery at runtime.
Use must remain factual and must not imply NASA endorsement.

reliefAsset.use: Tangent-space normal map derived from NASA LOLA elevation data.
